definitions.explanation: The highest academic degree awarded by a university, obtained after completing advanced research and a dissertation.

examples.japanese: {博士号|はくしごう}を{取得|しゅとく}した。
{彼|かれ}は{物理学|ぶつりがく}の{博士号|はくしごう}を{持|も}っている。
examples.english: He has a PhD in physics.

examples.japanese: {博士号|はくしごう}を{取|と}るまでに{五年|ごねん}かかったが、{研究|けんきゅう}を{続|つづ}けてよかったと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: It took five years to get my doctorate, but I'm glad I kept up my research.

notes:
{博士号|はくしごう} is a compound of {博士|はくし} (doctor, scholar) and {号|ごう} (title, designation).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {博士号|はくしごう}を{取得|しゅとく}する (to obtain a doctorate)
- {博士号|はくしごう}を{持|も}つ (to hold a doctorate)
- {博士号|はくしごう}を{授与|じゅよ}する (to confer a doctorate)

RELATED WORDS:
- {修士号|しゅうしごう}: master's degree
- {学士号|がくしごう}: bachelor's degree
- {博士課程|はくしかてい}: doctoral program
- {論文博士|ろんぶんはくし}: doctorate by thesis (without enrolling in a program)
